# SugarCRM | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Manufacturing channels and complex account sales | Using “lists or interactive entry - customer formation and business opportunities - advance phase” as the main link to trigger the next step - managing the double drive, to verify whether manufacturing channels and complex account sales actually reduce manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Professional services | The main link is “list or interactive entry - formation of customer and business - push phase” - triggers the next step - manage the double drive to verify whether professional services actually reduce manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| sales projections | Using “list or interactive entry - formation of customer and business - push phase” as the main link to trigger the next step - manage the double drive, to verify whether sales forecasts actually reduce manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Modernization of CRM with high data control requirements | Using the “list or interactive entry-forming customer and business-promoting phase-triggering the next step-managing double drive” as the main link to verify whether the modernization of CRM, which requires higher data control, really reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
